SELECT pl.program_id,
       pl.is_international,
       pl.class_year_normalized,
       pl.state_or_country,
       pl.country_code,
       pl.position_normalized,
       pl.position_detail,
       NULL AS weight_classes_listed,
       pl.height_inches,
       pl.pathway_type,
       pl.transfer_source_type,
       pl.previous_college
FROM players pl
JOIN programs p ON p.id = pl.program_id
JOIN sports s ON s.id = p.sport_id
JOIN program_seasons ps ON ps.program_id = p.id AND ps.roster_season = pl.roster_season
LEFT JOIN program_season_facts f ON f.program_id = p.id AND f.season = '2025-26'
WHERE s.code = 'soccer' AND pl.roster_season = '2025-26'
  AND ps.completeness = 'settled'
  AND COALESCE(pl.is_non_player, 0) = 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sport_scope sc
                   WHERE sc.sport_id = p.sport_id AND sc.gender = p.gender
                     AND sc.division = COALESCE(f.division, p.division) AND sc.status IN ('out_of_scope', 'not_sponsored'))
  AND COALESCE(f.program_status, '') <> 'suspended'
  AND p.id NOT IN (84, 173, 1138, 1292)
  AND p.gender = 'M'
  AND COALESCE(f.division, p.division) = 'D1'
ORDER BY pl.program_id, pl.id
